Strategy: Dual dead-zone avoidance. Exact fits score highest; both tiny residuals below a quarter of the item and awkward residuals between half and the full item score far lower, while other residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in either penalized zone while a looser bin avoids both. It may help by avoiding two kinds of unusable leftovers, but may fail if it pushes items into roomy bins too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-100.0 + (r - item) if r - item < item / 4 else (-(r - item) - 200.0 if r - item > item / 2 and r - item <= item else -(r - item))) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Dual dead-zone avoidance: penalize residual < item/4 and residual in (item/2, item], exact fit highest.
